data.indexCnDesc: 中证机器人指数选取系统方案商、数字化车间与生产线系统集成商、自动化设备制造商、自动化零部件商以及其它机器人相关上市公司证券作为指数样本，以反映上市公司中机器人相关证券的整体表现。
data.indexEnDesc: CSI Robot index selects the securities from the companies which provide software and hardware for robot manufacture，and other companies benefitting from robot. The index is designated to reflect the performance of robot securities and to provide underlying for investors.
